messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Typical long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|---------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Mon) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

> **Notes**  
> • Some holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day, Civic Holiday, etc.) are provincial and may create additional long weekends in specific provinces.  
> • Remembrance Day (Nov 11) is observed on Nov 10 in most provinces, so it does not form a long weekend.  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday, so it does not create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these date ranges into your holiday‑planning app!
